steps.name: a_ui_1600
steps.desc: the designer on core's temperate forest, proving ground, 1600x900: header with the budget meter, the asset picker over the slot list, the map, the ground strip

steps.name: b_oak_selected_1600
steps.desc: the oak rule selected: the inspector shows its placement; its slope curve is below

steps.name: c2_clicked_pine
steps.desc: a click on a pine of the map selected its rule: the pine chip and the inspector follow

steps.name: d_before_whole
steps.desc: before the slope edit: oak, birch and pine over the whole proving ground (dome top left, ridge top right, path, river, density zones in the meadow)

steps.name: d_before_dome
steps.desc: before: the slope dome (0 degrees at the summit to 60 at the foot)

steps.name: e_after_dome
steps.desc: after: a band curve on oak, birch and pine (slope 27 to 63 degrees only): the trees stand on the dome's flank and are gone from the flat ground

steps.name: e_after_whole
steps.desc: after, whole map, with the oak rule selected: its slope curve (a band) in the inspector

steps.name: f_undone_whole
steps.desc: three undos: the map is back to d_before_whole

steps.name: g_ground_changed
steps.desc: the ground surface changed to red sand: the session rebuilt the map from its document (the terrain reads the ground at build time); the plants stayed

steps.title: biome designer smoke
steps.intro: Core's temperate forest opened in the biome designer on the proving ground (core is the shipped library). a to c: the whole screen at 1600x900 and 1280x800. d to f: a slope band curve on the three canopy rules, before, after and undone; the scatter regenerates only the species the edit can change.
